newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel premiums gain on stronger demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel premiums gain on stronger demand.

text.p: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums gained around $2 on heavier demand, including fresh Scandinavian buying interest on Wednesday, traders said.
Benchmark Dec IPE futures advanced $1.5 to $224.25 a tonne, after bouncing off lows in sympathy with firmer Brent crude futures.
Cargo premiums were Dec IPE +$36 cif NWE with demand chasing limited supply. Barges remained around Dec IPE +$26 fob ARA.
The Med firmed around $2 to fob Med high +$5/8. Some cargoes were expected to come north from the Med in mid-month but would have to be broken up for onward sale.
